newsitem.title: USA: Mackie Designs sees lower Q3 results.
newsitem.headline: Mackie Designs sees lower Q3 results.

text.p: Mackie Designs on Thursday said earnings for the third quarter will be "materially lower" than analysts' estimates.

According to First Call the company was expected to earn a profit of $0.16 a share in the third quarter versus $0.19 a year ago. In a statement, the company said it attributed the shortfall to delays in the introduction of the new large- format 408 mixing board, originally slated for introduction in early third-quarter 1996.
The company said production will begin in the fourth quarter of 1996, delaying forecast revenues from this product by approximately two months.

Further pressure is felt by the greater-than-expected drop in sales in the professional audio industry during the typically slow summer period. Mackie is scheduled to report third quarter earnings on October 24.
